$comment: 语法大厅 G29（V0.9 P3 样课，进阶层首个大件）。比喻锚点：聚光灯换人：不管谁在弹，琴被弹响了。进阶层内容——KET 不直接考被动的复杂用法（ketRelevance 1，ketLessonMap null，据实标注不制造焦虑），为初中/PET 打底。暗线转向「英语的规律性」：被动结构里一人报时（be）、其余冻结（过去分词），同时过去分词又落回最常用最不规则那批词。全部内容原创。
title: 被动语态（各时态与情态动词）
metaphor: 聚光灯换人：不管谁在弹，琴被弹响了
ketNote: 老实说：KET 不直接考被动语态，A2 只要求见到常见被动说法能看懂。这一课是为初中和 PET 打底——现在弄懂「聚光灯换人」，初一学被动时就是复习。不用焦虑，学到就是赚到。

sections.essence: 聚光灯从人移到琴上：主语变成挨动作的一方，动词换上 be+过去分词。
sections.why: 中文说「票卖完了」「饭做好了」——票不会自己卖、饭不会自己做，可动词一点不变，全靠听的人心领神会，这叫意念被动。英语不行：英语靠语序认主角，站在句首的就是主语，如果不给动词换装，The guitar plays 就成了「琴自己在弹」。所以聚光灯一换人——把「挨动作的一方」请到句首——动词必须当场换上两件套：be + 过去分词，The guitar is played，琴被弹响了。谁弹的？想说就用 by 补一句，不想说干脆不提。初中和 PET 大量考被动；KET 只要求见到能懂，不直接考写——这课是提前打底。
sections.metaphorStory: 银帆乐队演出结束，灯光师傅给新来的学徒上课：「今晚的聚光灯有两种打法。第一种打在乐手身上——Tom plays the guitar，观众看的是谁在弹。第二种打在乐器上——The guitar is played，观众看的是琴被弹响了；到底谁弹的，可以用 by Tom 小声补一句，也可以干脆不说。」学徒问：「换灯有什么规矩？」师傅说：「琴挪到句首当主角后，动词必须换上两件套：be 加过去分词。be 负责报时——is、was、will be，一场一换；过去分词从头到尾不动，只举一块牌子：我是挨动作的。」有一晚学徒想把灯打给 happen（发生），追了半场没找到落点——「发生」没有挨动作的对象，聚光灯没地方落。师傅笑了：「所以 was happened 这盏灯，压根不存在。」

cards.rule: 被动两件套：be + 过去分词
cards.detail: 聚光灯移到「挨动作的一方」，它升到句首当主语，动词换上 be + 过去分词（动词第三形态）。
cards.example: Tom cleans the room. → The room is cleaned (by Tom).

cards.rule: be 管报时，过去分词永远不动
cards.detail: 各时态的被动只变 be：现在 am/is/are done · 过去 was/were done · 进行 is/was being done · 完成 have/has been done · 将来 will be done。分词纹丝不动。
cards.example: The bridge was built in 1958. / A new song is being recorded.

cards.rule: 情态动词的被动：情态 + be + 过去分词
cards.detail: can/must/should 等情态动词后面，be 永远用原形，三件一件不能少。
cards.example: Homework must be finished before nine. / The door can be opened easily.

cards.detail: 想强调谁干的，就用 by 补一句；不知道、不重要、不想说，就省掉——被动天生擅长把做事的人藏起来。
cards.example: My bike was stolen (by someone) last night. → My bike was stolen last night.

cards.detail: 三种情形：不知道谁做的 / 谁做的不重要 / 挨动作的才是话题中心。
cards.example: Paper was invented in China.（重点是纸，不是哪位古人）

cards.rule: 没有宾语的动词打不了这盏灯
cards.detail: happen / appear / arrive / die 这类不及物动词没有「挨动作的一方」，永远不用被动。
cards.example: The accident happened last night.（✗ was happened）

basic.en: English is spoken in many countries.
basic.cn: 很多国家都说英语。（is + spoken，聚光灯在英语上）

basic.en: The classroom is cleaned every day.
basic.cn: 教室每天都有人打扫。（挨动作的教室当主语）

basic.en: This song was written by our music teacher.
basic.cn: 这首歌是我们音乐老师写的。（write→written）

basic.en: My phone was made in Shenzhen.
basic.cn: 我的手机是深圳生产的。

basic.en: The guitar is played every evening.
basic.cn: 这把琴每天晚上都被弹响。（不管谁在弹）

mid.en: A new concert hall is being built near our school.
mid.cn: 我们学校附近正在建一座新音乐厅。（is being + built）

mid.en: All the tickets have been sold out.
mid.cn: 票已经全部卖完了。（have been done）

mid.en: The results will be announced next Friday.
mid.cn: 结果将于下周五公布。（will be done）

mid.en: The stage must be checked before the show.
mid.cn: 演出前舞台必须检查一遍。（情态 + be done）

mid.en: These photos were taken at the school gate.
mid.cn: 这些照片是在校门口拍的。（take→taken）

trap.en: The window was broken by the wind last night.
trap.note: break 的过去分词是 broken 不是 broke——be 后面只认第三形态。

trap.en: The accident happened at the crossing.
trap.note: happen 没有挨动作的对象——永远主动，was happened 是不存在的灯。

trap.en: The room was being cleaned when I came in.
trap.cn: 我进去时房间正在被打扫。
trap.note: 过去某刻正在被做：was being done——was cleaning 就成了房间自己在打扫。

trap.en: Rice is grown by farmers in the south.
trap.note: grow→grew→grown；「米被种」中文听着别扭，英文却最自然。

trap.en: The medicine must be kept away from children.
trap.cn: 药品必须放在孩子够不到的地方。
trap.note: must 后面 be 用原形——不是 must is kept。

trap.en: My homework was eaten by our dog — really!
trap.cn: 我的作业真的被我家狗吃了！
trap.note: eat→ate→eaten；这句的 by 短语是笑点担当，非说不可。

redBlack.bad: My little brother was hit me this morning.（想说：弟弟打了我）
redBlack.good: My little brother hit me this morning.
redBlack.why: 想说主动却套了被动壳——听的人以为弟弟挨了打，谁打谁全反了。

redBlack.bad: The fish ate.（想说：鱼被吃掉了）
redBlack.why: 不换灯，鱼就成了吃东西的一方——到底谁吃谁，意思全乱。

redBlack.bad: This book was wrote by a young teacher.
redBlack.good: This book was written by a young teacher.
redBlack.why: 被动只认第三形态——write→wrote→written，wrote 是过去式不是过去分词。

redBlack.bad: The accident was happened near the bridge.
redBlack.good: The accident happened near the bridge.
redBlack.why: happen 没有挨动作的对象——打不了被动这盏灯。

redBlack.good: The door can be opened easily.
redBlack.why: 情态动词后面 be 不能省——两件套缺了报时的那一件。

redBlack.bad: The room was cleaning when I came in.（想说：正在被打扫）
redBlack.good: The room was being cleaned when I came in.
redBlack.why: 进行时的被动是 be being done——was cleaning 成了房间自己在打扫。

redBlack.bad: A lot of trees have cut down this year.（想说：被砍掉了）
redBlack.good: A lot of trees have been cut down this year.
redBlack.why: 完成时的被动要 have been done——been 一丢，树就成了拿斧头的一方。
be 还要和主语对齐——letters 复数配 were（G25 的声部对齐在被动里照样生效）。

redBlack.bad: The cake was ate by my little sister.
redBlack.good: The cake was eaten by my little sister.
redBlack.why: eat→ate→eaten——be 后面永远第三形态。

redBlack.bad: The classroom is clean by us every day.
redBlack.good: The classroom is cleaned by us every day.
redBlack.why: is clean 是「教室很干净」，动作丢了——挨动作要用过去分词 cleaned。

redBlack.bad: The window got broken during the match.（有人说必须用 was）
redBlack.good: got broken / was broken 都行。
redBlack.why: 口语常用 get + 过去分词表「意外挨了一下」——不挡意思，考试也不设坑。

redBlack.bad: The song was sung by Amy and I.（有人觉得 I 更礼貌）
redBlack.good: The song was sung by Amy and me.
redBlack.why: 介词 by 后面用宾格 me——by ... and I 是过度纠正，但意思不挡。

contrast.cn: 票卖完了。（动词一点不变）
contrast.en: The tickets have been sold out.（have been + sold）
contrast.diff: 中文靠意会——票当然是被卖的；英语必须把「被」写在动词脸上。

contrast.cn: 他被批评了。（「被」常带倒霉味）
contrast.en: He was criticized. / He was praised.（好事坏事都能被动）
contrast.diff: 中文「被」字句偏爱不幸的事；英语被动是中性的机器，表扬照样用。

contrast.cn: 我的自行车被人偷了。（要垫个「人」）
contrast.en: My bike was stolen.（不知道谁偷的干脆不提）
contrast.diff: 英语被动天生擅长隐去做事的人；中文常要垫一个「被人」。
中文用「是……的」悄悄表被动；英语明着换 be + 过去分词。

contrast.cn: 门开了。（谁开的不说也通）
contrast.en: The door was opened. ≠ The door opened.
contrast.diff: 英语里 was opened 是「有人开的」，opened 是「门自己开了」——两件套和一件套，意思不同。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 先问主语挨不挨动作；挨 → be + 过去分词；be 管报时分词冻结，情态后面 be 原形。
steps: 问主语：它是做动作的，还是挨动作的？挨 → 换被动灯。
搭两件套：be + 过去分词——先想清动词的第三形态（不规则的回 G13 查那 40 位老团员）。
让 be 报时：现在 am/is/are · 过去 was/were · 进行 be being · 完成 have/has been · 将来 will be。
be 和主语对齐：单数 was、复数 were——声部别抢拍。
有情态动词？直接「情态 + be + 过去分词」，be 永远原形。
收尾自查：happen / arrive 这类没宾语的动词，永远打不了被动灯。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，英语句子像舞台：聚光灯打在做动作的人身上叫主动，移到挨动作的东西身上叫被动。咱们玩换灯游戏：我说一句中文，比如『汤姆打扫了教室』，你先用英语正常说一遍，再把聚光灯换到教室上——The classroom was cleaned by Tom. 我不懂英语没关系，我只当灯光师傅听两件事：换灯之后有没有 be 的音（is、was、been），动词有没有换成第三形态。听到 was cleaned、was eaten 就算换灯成功；听到 was clean、was ate 我就喊『两件套穿错了』。」再加一关：让孩子讲一件不知道谁干的事——书包被人翻过了、蛋糕被吃掉了——这正是被动最好用的时候。
questions: 「琴被弹响了」和「汤姆在弹琴」，聚光灯各打在谁身上？
被动的两件套是哪两件？哪一件管报时、哪一件永远不变？
为什么英语里不能说 was happened？「发生」缺了什么？

sections.echo: 被动的两件套里藏着英语的一条分工规律：一个结构里，永远只有一个成员管时间——be 包揽全部变形（is/was/been/being），过去分词从换上那一刻起就再也不动，像一块只写着「挨动作」的状态牌。这种「一人报时、其余冻结」的分工，接下来还会一再遇到（G30-G32 的非谓语是同一条规律的另外三张脸）。而那些状态牌本身——done、made、taken、gone、written——恰恰又是 G13 里那批最常用的老团员，第三形态照样不讲理。规律性与不规则并不矛盾：框架永远规整，最常用的零件永远最任性——这就是英语的秩序。

stages.name: 认一认 · 聚光灯在谁身上

questions.q: The guitar is played every evening. 这句的聚光灯打在谁身上？
questions.explain: 主语 the guitar 是挨动作的一方——聚光灯在琴上，被动。

questions.q: Tom plays the guitar. 这句是主动还是被动？
options: 主动：聚光灯在 Tom 身上
questions.explain: 主语 Tom 是做动作的一方——主动。

questions.q: 被动语态的「两件套」是？
questions.explain: 聚光灯换人后，动词必须换上 be + 过去分词。

questions.q: 两件套里负责报时（变时态）的是哪一件？
questions.explain: be 一场一换（is/was/will be…），分词纹丝不动。

questions.q: 两件套里永远不变的是哪一件？
questions.explain: 过去分词只举一块「我挨动作」的牌子，从不变形。

questions.q: clean 的过去分词是？
questions.explain: 规则动词的过去分词和过去式同形——cleaned。

questions.q: write 的过去分词是？
questions.explain: write→wrote→written——被动只认第三形态 written。

questions.q: steal（偷）的过去分词是？
questions.explain: steal→stole→stolen——was stolen 才是「被偷」。

questions.q: take 的过去分词是？
questions.explain: take→took→taken。

questions.q: break 的过去分词是？
questions.explain: break→broke→broken——was broken 才是「被打破」。

questions.q: make 的过去分词是？
questions.explain: make→made→made——过去式和过去分词同形。

questions.q: 被动句里想补一句「是谁干的」，用哪个词？
questions.explain: by + 做事的人——想强调就说，不想说就省。

questions.q: The window was broken. 这句说没说是谁打破的？
questions.explain: 被动天生擅长把做事的人藏起来——by 短语可省。

questions.q: happen（发生）能不能用被动？
options: 不能——它没有挨动作的对象
questions.explain: 没有宾语的动词打不了被动灯——was happened 不存在。

questions.q: My bike was stolen last night. 主语 my bike 是？
questions.explain: 自行车是被偷的一方——聚光灯在它身上。

questions.q: 下面哪一句是被动句？
options: The song was sung by Amy.
questions.explain: was sung——两件套齐全，聚光灯在歌上。

stages.name: 选一选 · be 来报时

questions.q: English ___ in many countries.
questions.explain: 英语是被说的一方——is + spoken。

questions.q: The classroom ___ every day after school.
questions.explain: 教室不会自己打扫——is cleaned。

questions.q: This bridge ___ in 1958.
questions.explain: 1958 年是过去——was + built（build→built）。

questions.q: These photos ___ at the school gate yesterday.
questions.explain: photos 复数配 were——be 要和主语对齐。

questions.q: A new hospital ___ near the park now.
questions.explain: 此刻正在被建——is being + built；is building 成了医院自己在施工。

questions.q: The tickets ___ already ___ out.
questions.explain: 完成时被动 have been done；tickets 复数用 have。

questions.q: The results ___ next Friday.
questions.explain: 将来的被动 will be done——三件套 will + be + announced。

questions.q: The stage must ___ before the show.
questions.explain: 情态后 be 用原形——must be checked。

questions.q: This kind of phone ___ in Shenzhen.
questions.explain: 手机是被生产的一方——is made。

questions.q: The floor ___ just now — it's still wet.
questions.explain: just now 过去——was washed；地板不会自己洗地。

questions.q: Dinner ___ by Grandpa every Sunday.
questions.explain: by Grandpa 提示被动——is cooked。

questions.q: The letter ___ to the wrong address last week.
questions.explain: send→sent——was send 少了第三形态的变形。

questions.q: Your homework must ___ before nine o'clock.
questions.explain: 情态 + be + 过去分词——三件一件不能少。

questions.q: The song can ___ by everyone in our class.
questions.explain: can be sung——sing→sang→sung。

questions.q: The window ___ by the wind last night.
questions.explain: be 后面要 broken——broke 是过去式不是分词。

questions.q: Rice ___ by farmers in the south.
questions.explain: by farmers 提示被动——is grown（grow→grown）。

questions.q: 哪一句的灯换对了？（这本书是鲁迅写的）
options: This book was written by Lu Xun.
This book was wrote by Lu Xun.
This book wrote by Lu Xun.
questions.explain: 被动只认第三形态 written——wrote 是过去式。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（事故昨晚发生）
options: The accident was happened last night.
The accident was happen last night.
questions.explain: happen 没有挨动作的对象——永远主动。

questions.q: 哪一句的灯换对了？（蛋糕被妹妹吃了）
options: The cake was eaten by my sister.
The cake was ate by my sister.
The cake was eat by my sister.
questions.explain: eat→ate→eaten——be 后面永远第三形态。

questions.q: 哪一句的灯换对了？（门可以轻松打开）
options: The door can be opened easily.
The door can is opened easily.
questions.explain: 情态后 be 不能省也不能变——can be opened。

questions.q: 哪一句的灯换对了？（教室正在被打扫）
options: The classroom is being cleaned now.
The classroom is been cleaned now.
questions.explain: 进行被动 is being done——is cleaning 成了教室自己干活。

questions.q: 哪一句的灯换对了？（很多树被砍掉了）
options: Many trees have been cut down.
Many trees have been cutted down.
questions.explain: 完成被动 have been done；cut 第三形态不变——cutted 是假章。

questions.q: 哪一句的灯换对了？（信件昨天寄出了）
questions.explain: 复数 letters 配 were；send→sent。

questions.q: 哪一句的灯换对了？（规则必须人人遵守）
options: The rules must be followed by everyone.
The rules must be follow by everyone.
The rules must followed by everyone.
questions.explain: 情态 + be + 过去分词——followed 的 -ed 和 be 都不能丢。

questions.q: 哪一句的灯换对了？（晚饭每天七点做好）
options: Dinner is cooked at seven every day.
Dinner is cook at seven every day.
Dinner cooks at seven every day.
questions.explain: be 后面要过去分词 cooked——晚饭不会自己做饭。

questions.q: 哪一句的灯换对了？（我的钱包在公交车上被偷了）
options: My wallet was stolen on the bus.
My wallet was stole on the bus.
My wallet stole on the bus.
questions.explain: steal→stole→stolen——被动要 stolen。

questions.q: 哪一句的灯换对了？（问题已经解决了）
questions.explain: 完成被动 has been solved——been 和 -ed 缺一不可。

questions.q: 哪一句的灯换对了？（这些椅子是木头做的）
options: These chairs are made of wood.
These chairs are make of wood.
questions.explain: be made of 也是两件套——are + made。

questions.q: 哪一句的灯换对了？（比赛因雨被推迟）
options: The match was put off because of the rain.
The match put off because of the rain.
The match was putted off because of the rain.
questions.explain: put 第三形态不变——was put off；putted 是假章。

questions.q: 哪一句的灯换对了？（新歌下个月录制）
options: A new song will be recorded next month.
A new song will record next month.
A new song will be record next month.
questions.explain: will be recorded——be 之后还得有第三形态。

questions.q: 哪一句的灯换对了？（孩子们应该因诚实被表扬）
options: The children should be praised for their honesty.
The children should praised for their honesty.
The children should be praise for their honesty.
questions.explain: 被动不只用于倒霉事——表扬照样 should be praised。

questions.q: 哪一句的灯换对了？（琴每天早上都响，不知道谁弹的）
options: The piano is played every morning.
The piano plays itself every morning.
The piano is play every morning.
questions.explain: 不知道谁干的正是被动的主场——is played，by 短语干脆不提。

questions.q: Paper ___ in China more than two thousand years ago.
questions.explain: 重点在纸不在人，且是两千年前——过去被动 was invented。

questions.q: My brother ___ the window, so he ___ by Mum.
questions.explain: 打破窗户是主动 broke；挨批评是被动 was criticized——一句两盏灯。

questions.q: The concert hall ___ five years ago and ___ by thousands of people every year.
questions.explain: 两处都是被动：过去 was built，习惯 is visited。

questions.q: — Where ___ your watch ___? — In Shenzhen.
questions.explain: 疑问句里的被动：Where was it made?——be 提前，made 不动。

questions.q: The lost dog ___ yet.
questions.explain: 狗是被找的一方——完成被动的否定 hasn't been found。

questions.q: Don't worry — your computer ___ right now.
questions.explain: 正在被修——is being repaired；is repairing 成了电脑自己在修东西。

questions.q: The medicine ___ away from children.
questions.explain: 药是被收好的一方——must be kept（keep→kept）。

questions.q: A speech ___ by the headmaster tomorrow morning.
questions.explain: give→gave→given——will be given。

questions.q: The room ___ when I came in, so I waited outside.
questions.explain: 过去某刻正在被打扫——was being cleaned；came in 提示整句在过去。

questions.q: This word ___ in two different ways.
questions.explain: 词是被读的一方——can be pronounced。

questions.q: The classroom ___ every day, but yesterday it ___ because we all left early.
questions.explain: 两处被动：习惯 is cleaned，昨天没被打扫 wasn't cleaned。

questions.q: — Who ___ this beautiful song? — It ___ by our music teacher.
questions.explain: 问「谁写的」灯在人身上用主动 wrote；答句灯在歌上用被动 was written。

questions.q: The accident ___ at the crossing, and two people ___ to hospital.
questions.explain: happen 永远主动；人被送医院——were taken。

questions.q: Hundreds of photos ___ since the band started the tour.
questions.explain: photos 复数 → have been taken；have taken 成了照片自己拍别人。

questions.q: Bikes ___ here — look at the sign.
questions.explain: 标志对「车」说话——车是被停的一方：mustn't be parked。

questions.q: 大考：The song ___ last year, ___ by millions now, and ___ at our concert next week.
options: was written / is loved / will be sung
was written / loves / will be sung
questions.explain: 三盏被动灯三种报时：过去 was written、现在 is loved、将来 will be sung——be 换脸，分词纹丝不动。

detective.sentence: This story was wrote by a student in Grade 9.
detective.fixed: This story was written by a student in Grade 9.
detective.clue: 被动只认第三形态——write→wrote→written，wrote 混进来就是两件套穿错。

detective.sentence: The accident was happened outside the school gate.
detective.fixed: The accident happened outside the school gate.
detective.clue: happen 没有挨动作的对象——这盏被动灯根本不存在。

detective.sentence: My schoolbag was steal on the bus yesterday.
detective.fixed: My schoolbag was stolen on the bus yesterday.
detective.clue: be 后面要过去分词 stolen——steal 是原形，不能光着上台。

detective.sentence: The dishes must be wash before we go out.
detective.fixed: The dishes must be washed before we go out.
detective.clue: 情态 + be + 过去分词——washed 的 -ed 不能丢。

detective.sentence: A new library is building near our school.
detective.fixed: A new library is being built near our school.
detective.clue: 图书馆不会自己施工——正在被建要用 is being built。

detective.sentence: The windows was closed by the teacher after class.
detective.fixed: The windows were closed by the teacher after class.
detective.clue: be 要和主语对齐——windows 复数配 were，声部别抢拍。

detective.sentence: The mooncakes were ate by us in ten minutes.
detective.fixed: The mooncakes were eaten by us in ten minutes.
detective.clue: eat→ate→eaten——ate 是过去式，被动要第三形态 eaten。
